grid_co2_india.source_name: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, Version 22.0 (weighted average, incl. renewable generation)
grid_co2_india.uncertainty: Annual grid average for FY 2025-26; actual marginal emissions vary by region, season and hour. CO2 only (CH4/N2O not included).

car_avg.unit: kg CO2e per km (average car, unknown fuel type)
car_avg.source_name: UK DEFRA/DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2024, condensed set
car_avg.uncertainty: UK average fleet; Indian petrol/diesel cars are broadly comparable in size and emissions class, but this is a proxy, not an India-specific factor.

rail_national.source_name: UK DEFRA/DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2024, condensed set
rail_national.uncertainty: UK national rail (mostly electrified); Indian metro rail draws from the Indian grid, which is more carbon-intensive per kWh than UK rail traction. Proxy factor.

lpg_kg.unit: kg CO2e per kg LPG burnt
lpg_kg.source_name: UK DEFRA/DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2024, condensed set
lpg_kg.uncertainty: Combustion emissions only; LPG composition (propane/butane mix) varies slightly by country.

induction_efficiency.unit: fraction of energy transferred to food (induction cooking, 'up to')
induction_efficiency.source_name: Sweeney et al., ACEEE Summer Study on Energy Efficiency in Buildings (2014), Induction Cooking Technology Design and Assessment
induction_efficiency.uncertainty: ACEEE reports 'up to 90%'; measured efficiency varies with vessel and use (the same paper shows induction is not always more efficient in practice).

gas_efficiency.unit: fraction of energy transferred to food (LPG gas stove)
gas_efficiency.source_name: Sweeney et al., ACEEE Summer Study on Energy Efficiency in Buildings (2014), Induction Cooking Technology Design and Assessment
gas_efficiency.uncertainty: Gas-stove efficiency measured on US equipment; Indian LPG burner stoves are in a similar class.

lpg_kwh_per_kg.unit: kWh per kg LPG (net CV basis)
lpg_kwh_per_kg.source_name: UK DEFRA/DESNZ GHG conversion factors 2024, Fuel properties table
lpg_kwh_per_kg.uncertainty: Energy content, not an emission factor; LPG propane/butane mix varies slightly.
